followUpDefects.scope: Three confirmed inventory defects corrected locally; baseline evidence retained below.

baselineFindings.detail: Standalone inventory valuation still reads the legacy 500-product list, understating the complete store value.
A failed valuation load is presented as zero inventory rather than an error with retry.
The advertised 30-day calculation considers the latest 100 orders without filtering dates or paid status.

findings.implementation: Complete catalogue enumeration before computing totals; 50 rendered rows per page.
findings.regression: 501 products at stock 1 and cost 100 produce asset value 50100, retail value 100200 and gross margin 50100.

findings.implementation: Loading and failed reads hide metrics and empty results; explicit retry recovers the complete catalogue.
findings.regression: HTTP 503 shows error/retry, no false zero value. Recovery displays full 50100 asset value.

findings.implementation: Store-scoped server report examines all positive-quantity paid sales within a pinned rolling 30-day UTC window, with 50-row cursor pages.
findings.regression: 620 products and 120 paid orders exercise both former caps; 501 eligible products paginate without duplicates. Old, pending, failed, voided, future and nonpositive-quantity sales do not hide stock. Bounds, store/role/plan access and error/retry are checked.
